verdict.rationale: Obsidian's docs say notes are plain Markdown files stored locally on your device, giving you full control over where your data lives. They also document syncing through your own choice of backend (Obsidian Sync, Dropbox, iCloud, OneDrive, Git and others), and a community user confirms keeping notes only locally plus their chosen sync. Missing for 10: region/residency selection for Obsidian's own hosted services (Sync servers, Publish), explicit data-residency documentation.
